mapper.sql: a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, a.amount AS cashAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') THEN 1 END) AS holdingCount, MAX(CASE WHEN dsb.status IN ('TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasRestrictedHolding
FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN domestic_stock_balance dsb ON dsb.account_id = a.account_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_no, c.name, a.amount ORDER BY a.account_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id ) counted

SELECT dp.domestic_product_id AS domesticProductId, dp.ticker AS ticker, dp.name AS name, dp.type AS type, dp.domestic_stock_ratio AS domesticStockRatio, dp.inception_date AS inceptionDate, dsb.qty AS qty, dsb.status AS status, dsb.last_purchase_date AS lastPurchaseDate, dsb.avg_purchase_price AS avgPurchasePrice FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE dsb.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY dsb.last_purchase_date DESC
